value.author: pi-glm
value.text:
Root cause found for the packed-CLI slowdown (CI 41444134292, Node 26 ETIMEDOUTs; Node 22 2x). Method: interleaved A/B on the same host (packed-loop harness + the two packed tests), SDK chunk stack tracing, strace execve counts, per-SDK-method timing instrumentation, and node --cpu-prof.

ROOT CAUSE: commit a033367 moved ensurePersistentTypes into createRlItem, so every created item re-issued all 9 schemaAddType SDK calls. Each schemaAddType re-resolves the merge-attribute workspace and spawns 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel' (PATH-scanned: 2700 execve attempts for 225 invocations in one 3-generation loop; main does 45). One packed lm loop: 25 creates x 9 types = 225 git spawns; the loop test fixture loop: 243 schemaAddType calls through one client. Each invocation costs ~40-50ms on CI runners, which dominates the packed-CLI wall time (per-SDK-method timing measured schemaAddType at 48ms/call; gets ~12-17ms are fs-latency-bound and unchanged in nature).

FIX: index.ts ensurePersistentTypes now memoizes one completed installation per PmClient in-process (WeakSet). schemaAddType stays byte-idempotent, a fresh process/client/faulted installation still re-runs the full sequence, and every create is still preceded by an installed schema. All durability, drift and refusal guarantees retained; no timeout raised, no assertion weakened, nothing skipped.

value.author: pi-glm
value.text:
A/B evidence, interleaved pairs on the same host (packed 3-generation lm loop, harness-measured ms; full packed tests in parentheses).

BEFORE (branch pre-fix vs main):
- lm loop, node 24: branch 30911/27949/27527 vs main 21865/19534/18016 (branch mean ~28.8s vs main ~19.8s, +45%).
- lm loop, node 26: branch 23212/21662/18822 vs main 15454/14307/13368 (+47%).
- packed lm test: branch failed the <20s assertion (21.3-23.2s measured); packed process test failed all 3 rounds at the unchanged 20s subprocess timeout (branch wall 30.2-30.3s) while main passed at 13.8-17.7s measured.
- spawn counts per lm loop: branch 225 git invocations (2700 execve attempts) + 12 getconf; main 45 (540).

AFTER (branch fixed vs main):
- lm loop, node 24: branch 19950/20920/20038 vs main 19733/17309/20623 (+6%, within host noise).
- lm loop, node 26: branch 20745/16380/15936 vs main 17512/15712/15131 (~+10% mean, residual is the branch's added drift-verification reads which are kept by design).
- packed lm test: passes, 16569/16761 ms vs the unchanged 20-second assertion.
- packed process test: passes all 3 rounds, 16431/17116/15085 ms measured vs main 13269/14279/16832.
- spawn counts per lm loop: branch 9 git invocations (108 execve attempts), below main's 45.

Remaining ~5-10% gap vs main comes from the branch's additional drift-verification SDK reads (543 gets vs 360, 372 config reads vs 140) which are part of the added guarantees and are fs-latency-bound, not process spawns.
